author: North
name: VoiceTranscribe
short: Automatically reply to native Discord voice notes with text.
description: Uses local faster-whisper speech recognition (no paid API) to transcribe native Discord voice messages and reply in text. A server admin enables it with [p]vt on. It never joins voice channels.
install_msg: Local faster-whisper is installed with the cog. Enable it using [p]vt on. On first use, the base model downloads to the VPS. Requires outbound access for model download and Message Content Intent.
end_user_data_statement: No end-user audio or transcript history is stored in Red configuration. Voice note audio is briefly copied to a temporary file and deleted after processing; the transcription is posted to Discord and retained according to Discord/server policies. The speech model runs locally, and model weights are downloaded on first use.
